title: arashouse git-baseline --json
description: What `arashouse git-baseline --json` prints: the leased slot and its git baseline. It holds no file contents and no secret.

git.description: A failed baseline exits 10 (or 7 when a guard refused it), with the lease still held.

ok.description: The repository is in the slot's tree and the slot came back up.

commit.description: The baseline commit, once one was made; null when the baseline failed before it.

files.description: Files the commit holds, the generated .gitignore among them.

path.description: The repository's work tree, the slot's Innovator folder, as a Windows path.

detail.description: One line: what was done, with its times, or why it failed.
